verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion control is a fair question for a managed database service, but the evidence pack never documents it. There are no retention policies, TTL or expiry settings, data or account deletion workflows, or configurable backup retention. The closest items are adjacent: automated daily backups, point-in-time recovery, throwaway agent branches, and BYOC data residency. None of these gives the user documented control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
